title: 18 great minds argue about your idea

lines.text: Claude says *yes* to every idea you have. | So someone built *eighteen great minds* | to tear it *apart.*
It's an *open-source* plugin | called *Council of High Intelligence,* | with over *four thousand* stars on GitHub.
Type *slash council* and your question, | and it goes to a panel like *Socrates,* | *Feynman,* and *Charlie Munger.*
Each one makes up their mind *blind* first, | so nobody just copies the *loudest* voice.
Then they *cross-examine* each other. | Socrates attacks your *assumptions.* | Munger asks what would make it *fail.* | Kahneman hunts for the *bias* you can't see.
Then you get a *verdict:* | what's still *unresolved,* | where they *split,* | the *kill criteria,* | and one *next step.*
One AI will always say *yes.* | *Eighteen* won't.
Comment *COUNCIL,* | and I'll send you where to learn *AI tools* like this.

sources: github.com/0xNyk/council-of-high-intelligence (read 2026-10-09): MIT licence, ~4.6k stars, 18 personas incl. Socrates (assumption destruction), Feynman, Charlie Munger (inversion), Daniel Kahneman (cognitive bias); /council <question>; members 'analyze blind' and the council 'keeps their first positions independent', then cross-examine; verdict leads with unresolved questions, preserves dissent, gives kill criteria and one concrete next step; works in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode
teyro.app (read 2026-10-09): AI track = Use AI tools · Build AI agents · Create automations. No Claude Code-specific claim is made in the video.
